lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments and abrupt terminations observed on lines 1, 2, and 12, where the lines break into isolated blobs before reaching the ventral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white crescent-shaped patch on the lower throat region and two distinct white spots visible on the lateral cheek area.
